# old-invocation-allowlist.txt — files that may still name the old setup invocation (spec 0256
# R33, R34). scripts/tests/setup-references.test.ts fails on any other tracked or untracked text
# file, outside specs/ and docs/adr/, that names `bash` followed by one of the four setup shell
# scripts. The scripts are forwarding shims now: the instruction is `node
# scripts/setup-<cli>-interactive.ts` behind the Node.js floor guard (or the Taskfile).
#
# Format: one repo-relative path per line; an entry ending in `/` covers every file below that
# directory. Every entry carries a reason as the `#` comment line directly above it. An entry
# that no longer matches a file with a hit, or that appears twice, fails the suite.

# This file, its suite and the hint-string suite: they spell the invocation they scan for or pin.
scripts/tests/fixtures/setup/old-invocation-allowlist.txt
scripts/tests/setup-references.test.ts
scripts/tests/setup-hint-strings.test.ts

# The four shims themselves: each header names the invocation it keeps working.
scripts/setup-claude-interactive.sh
scripts/setup-gemini-interactive.sh
scripts/setup-copilot-interactive.sh
scripts/setup-antigravity-interactive.sh

# The shim path is part of the user-visible repair hint of the MemPalace session-start check
# ("run bash scripts/setup-<cli>-interactive.sh"); the shim keeps the name, and
# scripts/tests/setup-hint-strings.test.ts pins it.
scripts/lib/mempalace-registration.ts

# The shim suite names the invocation it proves: a caller of the old path reaches the entry.
scripts/tests/setup-shim.test.ts

# The adoption guide says the old `bash scripts/setup-<cli>-interactive.sh` form still works: it
# documents that the shim forwards to the TypeScript entry.
docs/adoption-guide.md

# The ChromaDB runbook says each old invocation still works: it is a forwarding shim.
docs/runbooks/chroma-http-server.md

# The usage guide says the old invocation form still works: it is a forwarding shim.
docs/usage-guide.md
